primaryWitnesses.text: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
